mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sol_construction_plan ( project_id, current_duration_revision_id, pending_change_id, plan_recalculation_status_code, plan_recalculation_source_revision_id, version, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, tenant_id ) VALUES ( #{row.projectId}, #{row.currentDurationRevisionId}, #{row.pendingChangeId}, #{row.planRecalculationStatusCode}, #{row.planRecalculationSourceRevisionId}, #{row.version}, COALESCE(#{row.creator}, ''), COALESCE(#{row.createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), COALESCE(#{row.updater}, ''), COALESCE(#{row.updateTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), #{row.tenantId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sol_construction_plan SET current_duration_revision_id = #{update.currentDurationRevisionId}, pending_change_id = #{update.pendingChangeId}, plan_recalculation_status_code = #{update.planRecalculationStatusCode}, plan_recalculation_source_revision_id = #{update.planRecalculationSourceRevisionId}, updater = #{update.updater}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{update.tenantId} AND id = #{update.planId} AND version = #{update.expectedVersion} AND deleted = b'0'
